signals.title: Outflow is higher than income
signals.summary: Outflow is 150% of income for the selected month.
signals.detail: Spending more than income usually means savings fall or debt rises unless this is a planned one-off month.

signals.title: Card utilisation over 90%
signals.summary: Maxed card is at 98% of its credit limit.
signals.detail: Very high utilisation can drag down a credit-score estimate and leaves little room for interest, fees, or unexpected spending.

signals.title: Overall credit utilisation over 80%
signals.detail: High total utilisation is a classic pressure signal. Paying balances below 50%, then below 30%, usually gives the forecast more breathing room.

signals.title: Debt payments need watching
signals.summary: Tracked monthly payments are 31.5% of income.
signals.detail: This payment load can limit saving and absorb cash-flow shocks, especially if income varies month to month.
